sources.double ratio: Antusch, Hinze and Saad, 'Updated Running Quark and Lepton Parameters at Various Scales', arXiv:2510.01312v2 [hep-ph] (23 Mar 2026); the PDF https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.01312v2 fetched 2026-10-13, sha256 64e1d141cdfb2bcd3f45efe0b16e3ebdfa6130fd27f361d14353ecbb96d2aabd. Section 4.3, eqs. (4.6), (4.7) and (4.9), and section 4.1, eqs. (4.1) and (4.2) (MSSM, M_GUT = 2e16 GeV). The paper calls the double ratio 'highly stable under RG running and threshold corrections'. Read by the SM-derivation seat for A2 of its plan (the owner's approval, 2026-10-13).

as_printed.(4.9): (c_e, c_mu) = (4/9, 9/2), single operator dominance: y_mu y_d / (y_s y_e) = 10.125; 'the PDG 2024 result ... places it in tension at more than 4 sigma'
